Snippet.Name: ArubaOS-CX SNMPv3 User
Snippet.Description: Create an SNMPv3 user with SHA authentication and AES encryption on ArubaOS-CX switches.
Snippet.Commands: ! Define SNMPv3 user with SHA auth and AES privacy on ArubaOS-CX snmpv3 user ${SNMPv3 Username|text|^[A-Za-z0-9_.-]{1,32}$} auth sha auth-pass plaintext ${Auth Password|password|^.{8,64}$} priv aes priv-pass plaintext ${Privacy Password|password|^.{8,64}$}
